data.name: Fluffy Tower Defense
data.detailed_description:
Build. Burn. Freeze. Poison!

Waves of furry critters are coming for you!

Deer



Huskies



Even tigers



It's your job to stop them! All year long!
Sunshine, rain or snow: they don't stop, and neither should you!

Place towers, combine their effects, watch as fire, ice, poison and lightning clash in chaotic ways. But be careful: fire and ice cancel each other out - and enemies don't just take it lying down. Some are fast, some armored, some heal themselves - and all of them want through.

At the end of each level? Brutal challenge waves that give no gold and no mercy - just a chance to prove your build and climb the leaderboards.

What's in the realm?

  • 14 unique towers: from the classic arrow shooters to furball launchers and even hypnotic beams that send enemies moonwalking backwards.
  • Combos: burn them, freeze them, gas them - watch what happens when the effects combine.
  • Seasonal battles: levels are themed by the months of the year, with weather effects that change the feel of the battlefield.
  • Highscore chase: replay any level to beat your own score, or your friend's.
  • Map editor: design your own, build your waves and share the madness.

The towers

Arrow Blunt
Target an enemy and let it feel the... sharp sting?



Arrow Fire
Set it ablaze, dealing damage over time.



Arrow Ice
Slow it to a crawl.



Arrow Poison
For the undecided (or is it?), combining the effects of both fire and ice - but milder.



Cannon Blunt
Send cannonballs flying through the air, with a splash effect on impact.



Cannon Gas
Fill the field with deadly clouds, damaging any enemy passing through.



Cannon Oil
Sprinkle oil patches in their path, slowing every unit passing through.



Cannon Furball
Clamp the roads with furballs, damaging and slowing any critter unfortunate enough to stumble into them.



Sniper
Those armored units sure don't like it, as it pierces through.



Shotgun
Shoot scattered projectiles, damaging anything that comes close.



Laser
Focus, focus!



Lightning
Lightning bolts with chain bounces, don't wanna be too close to your critter buddy!



Hypnotic
Where are you going?



Stasis
Slows the blood flow, increasing damage.



The effects

Explosions, Toxic and Snow Clouds
When burning, poisoned or frozen units come in contact with gas clouds, they won't be celebrating.



Burning and Acid Patches, Ice Slicks
Burning, poisoned or frozen critters better watch their step - walking into oil patches won't be too much fun... for them.



Burning, Venom and Razor Furballs
If you're burning, poisoned or are frozen - avoid furballs at any cost... if you can.



It's cute. It's chaotic. It's competitive.

Tower placement is everything. Plan it right and watch them wipe the board. Do it wrong and... well, at least enjoy the furball mayhem!

Twelve months. Every day a new wave. Can you outlast the year?

data.short_description: Build towers, unleash fire, ice, poison and lightning upon waves of furry critters that run throughout all four seasons. Crazy combos, chain reactions and endless mayhem: can you survive the year?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: i5-6600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 770 4GB
  • Storage: 40 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game currently uses a fixed window size of 1312x969
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: i7-4790K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1080 8GB
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game currently uses a fixed window size of 1312x969
